title: Wurtzite AlN and (Al,B)N: polarization switching path, barrier and Berry-phase polarization

decision_points.fork: Which neb.x run is the (Al,B)N minimum-energy path: the converged first-stage NEB (collective, 7.35 eV/cell), the crashed refined_NEB, or the converged 75-image refined_NEB2
decision_points.wrong_choice: Take the first-stage NEB (the 'NEB' folder) as the path
decision_points.consequence: AlBN barrier 460 instead of 200 meV/f.u.; saddle at the half-reversed midpoint; mode reported collective

decision_points.fork: Identifying the homogeneous (collective) (Al,B)N path among the runs, from structure (every cation planar at its saddle)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Assume the collective barrier is composition-independent and reuse AlN's
decision_points.consequence: 523 vs 460 meV/f.u. (+14%); hides that homogeneous effects lower the barrier by only ~12%
Barriers off by x1/2 or x16

decision_points.fork: Berry phase is defined modulo the quantum eR/Omega (0.472 / 0.481 C/m^2 here)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the printed P values directly
decision_points.consequence: Ps ~0.1-0.16 C/m^2 (resembles zinc-blende-referenced literature values) instead of ~1.3

decision_points.fork: How densely to buy Berry images to unwrap the branch under a 28-unit budget (AlN steps reach 0.119 C/m^2 per image; half quantum 0.236)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Nearest-branch unwrapping at stride 2 (AlN half path) or stride 6 (AlBN)
decision_points.consequence: Ps off by one quantum or more (AlN -0.85, AlBN -0.40)

decision_points.fork: Branch from a Born-charge (or displacement) estimate: over short segments or end to end
decision_points.wrong_choice: Estimate the whole-path change from the two end images with ground-state Z*
decision_points.consequence: Z* grows along the path; the 10% underestimate exceeds half a quantum and picks the wrong branch (AlN -1.08, AlBN -1.12)

decision_points.fork: Reference for (Al,B)N, whose path has no layered-hexagonal image
decision_points.wrong_choice: Take the metastable half-switched intermediate (P close to 0) as the nonpolar reference

decision_points.fork: Mapping Berry folders (0-based NN_image, provenance unstated) to NEB images (1-based, neb.x numbering); checkable via scf energies
decision_points.wrong_choice: Match folder NN to NEB image NN

decision_points.fork: Multi-hump (Al,B)N path: global maximum and lowest intermediate vs the first sub-barrier and first minimum
decision_points.wrong_choice: Stop at the first hump / first local minimum
decision_points.consequence: Barrier 153 meV/f.u., saddle dP 0.50; intermediate 135 meV/f.u. with 4 inverted cations

decision_points.fork: Mechanism from image-resolved cation offsets rather than from the barrier
decision_points.wrong_choice: Collective switching through the layered-hexagonal state

length_estimate.why: Four to six NEB logs must be read for convergence and compared; collective vs non-collective paths identified from structures; 10-15 Berry outputs parsed and their branches fixed under a budget that forbids dense unwrapping (Born-charge or displacement estimates over short segments); folder-to-image mapping discovered; per-cation polarity analysis at the intermediate.

notes: Deviations from the catalog design: no fresh pw.x mode (no zinc-blende reference is archived; the zinc-blende convention is a rubric point and its numerical analogue, raw end-state Berry values ~0.1 C/m^2, is ablation dp4); the AlBN/AlN barrier ratio is not graded separately (it follows from the two graded barriers); the coercive field is a rubric point (homogeneous estimates are convention-dependent). Added graded quantities: collective (Al,B)N barrier, saddle polarization change and the intermediate state.
